label: Projected identity returns without lifting or with an infinite fibre
paraphrase: Two mathematical controls on the same two-actual-bearer q.3 a.4 profile with reciprocal actual esse supply and one identity bearer. The three exercise tokens A₀→B₁→A₂ have acyclic edges, an exact existence-based projection, finite nonempty identity fibres and fail universal backward lifting. An alternating chain of exercises, with n+1 supplying n, has acyclic edges and the same exact projection, lifts every actual esse-supplier edge from every eligible recipient exercise and has a nonempty infinite fibre at the identity bearer. The bearer relation has a nonempty finite return through that identity.
